segments.ja382:1.1: Kā nu kāḷena vaṇṇena, na cāpi [na cāsi (sī.)] piyadassanā;
segments.ja382:1.3: Kā vā tvaṃ kassa vā dhītā, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ.
segments.ja382:2.3: Ahaṃ kāḷī alakkhikā, kāḷakaṇṇīti maṃ vidū;
segments.ja382:2.5: Okāsaṃ yācito dehi, vasemu tava santike.
segments.ja382:3.3: Puṭṭhā me kāḷi akkhāhi, kathaṃ [yathā (sī. pī.)] jānemu taṃ mayaṃ.
segments.ja382:4.1: Makkhī paḷāsī sārambhī, issukī maccharī saṭho;
segments.ja382:4.3: So mayhaṃ puriso kanto, laddhaṃ yassa vinassati.
segments.ja382:5.1: Kodhano upanāhī ca, pisuṇo ca vibhedako;
segments.ja382:5.3: Kaṇḍakavāco [aṇḍakavāco (ka. sī. pī.)] pharuso, so me kantataro tato.
segments.ja382:7.3: So mayhaṃ puriso kanto, tasmiṃ homi anāmayā.
segments.ja382:8.1: Apehi etto tvaṃ kāḷi, netaṃ amhesu vijjati;
segments.ja382:9.1: Ahampi kho taṃ [cetaṃ (sī.)] jānāmi, netaṃ tumhesu vijjati;
segments.ja382:9.3: Santi loke alakkhikā, saṅgharanti bahuṃ dhanaṃ;
segments.ja382:9.5: Ahaṃ devo ca me bhātā, ubho naṃ vidhamāmase.
segments.ja382:10.1: Kā nu dibbena vaṇṇena, pathabyā supatiṭṭhitā;
segments.ja382:10.3: Kā vā tvaṃ kassa vā dhītā, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ.
segments.ja382:11.3: Ahaṃ sirī ca lakkhī ca, bhūripaññāti maṃ vidū;
segments.ja382:11.5: Okāsaṃ yācito dehi, vasemu tava santike.
segments.ja382:12.3: Puṭṭhā me lakkhi akkhāhi, kathaṃ [yathā (sī. pī.)] jānemu taṃ mayaṃ.
segments.ja382:13.1: Yo cāpi sīte athavāpi uṇhe, vātātape ḍaṃsasarīsape ca;
segments.ja382:13.3: Khudhaṃ [khuddaṃ (syā. ka.), khudaṃ (pī.)] pipāsaṃ abhibhuyya sabbaṃ, rattintivaṃ yo satataṃ niyutto;
segments.ja382:14.1: Kālāgatañca na hāpeti atthaṃ, so me manāpo nivise ca tamhi.
segments.ja382:14.3: Akkodhano mittavā cāgavā ca, sīlūpapanno asaṭhojubhūto [asaṭho ujjubhūto (pī.)];
segments.ja382:15.3: Tasmiṃhaṃ [tasmāhaṃ (sī. pī.)] pose vipulā bhavāmi, ūmi samuddassa yathāpi vaṇṇaṃ.
segments.ja382:16.1: Yo cāpi mitte athavā amitte, seṭṭhe sarikkhe atha vāpi hīne;
segments.ja382:16.3: Atthaṃ carantaṃ athavā anatthaṃ, āvī raho saṅgahameva vatte [vatto (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja382:17.1: Vācaṃ na vajjā pharusaṃ kadāci, matassa jīvassa ca tassa homi.
segments.ja382:17.3: Etesaṃ yo aññataraṃ labhitvā, kantā sirī [kantasiriṃ (katthaci), kantaṃ siriṃ (syā.) aṭṭhakathāyaṃ dutiyatatiyapāṭhantarāni] majjati appapañño;
segments.ja382:17.5: Taṃ dittarūpaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, karīsaṭhānaṃva [karīsajātaṃ va (sī. syā.)] vivajjayāmi.
segments.ja382:18.3: Na hi lakkhiṃ alakkhiṃ vā, añño aññassa kārakoti.
